class.name: VirtualGeometryAssembly
class.experimental: Nanite Assemblies are experimental and off by default.
class.brief_description: Experimental hierarchical part assembly payload for [VirtualGeometryData].
class.description: Holds a set of virtualized part [Mesh] resources with local [Transform3D] placements and optional child [VirtualGeometryAssembly] resources up to [constant MAX_DEPTH] (2) levels deep. Attach a [VirtualGeometryAssembly] to [member VirtualGeometryData.assembly] to enable GPU-side assembly expansion in NextGeo visibility, VSM, and ray-tracing passes when [member ProjectSettings.rendering/nextgeo/experimental/assemblies] is enabled.

method.name: add_child_assembly
method.description: Appends a child [VirtualGeometryAssembly] with local [param transform]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param child] is null, cyclic, or would exceed [constant MAX_DEPTH] (2) levels.

method.name: add_part
method.description: Appends a virtualized part [param mesh] placed at local [param transform].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all parts and child assemblies.

method.name: get_child_assembly_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct child assemblies.

method.name: get_depth
method.description: Returns the hierarchy depth of this assembly ([code]0[/code] when empty, [code]1[/code] for direct parts only, [code]2[/code] when child assemblies with parts are present).

method.name: get_merged_aabb
method.description: Returns the local-space [AABB] enclosing all direct and child assembly parts.

method.name: get_part_count
method.description: Returns the number of direct parts.

method.name: get_total_leaf_part_count
method.description: Returns the total number of expanded leaf part instances across this assembly and all direct child assemblies.

members.member: Direct child [VirtualGeometryAssembly] resources (at most two hierarchy levels total).
Direct virtualized part [Mesh] resources referenced by this assembly.

constants.constant: Maximum supported assembly nesting depth (root assembly -> child assembly -> part mesh).
